scope: Trusted native broker pre-creation capacity and physical retirement
invariants: Trusted broker must reserve a handle credit BEFORE an OS-capable resource is constructed.
Each permit charges context and every ancestor's handle and truthfully attributed byte quotas.
Actor STOP, scope revocation and context shutdown deny NEW permits; existing permits remain counted until abort or physical resource retirement.
Permit admission must serialize with exact actor-incarnation STOP; permission-scope ancestry is not actor liveness.
A trusted successful attach transfers the exact original reservation to the real resource without refund/re-reserve.
Construction failure aborts an unused permit and refunds its charges exactly once.
Constructed resource after STOP/shutdown is rejected from guest publication, retains its physical ownership and must be quarantined.
Context cannot report physically retired while an untransferred creation permit or registered resource remains.
Forged/cross-context, repeated attach, duplicate retire and stale generations are denied.
Bytes are trusted declared attribution, not actual kernel/heap measurement; unknown bytes still cost one handle.
